titleProfile: Solutions Architect · Core Banking Modernization · Microservices & AWS Cloud
descriptionProfile: Systems Engineer with a double master's degree and 9+ years leading the design and modernization of transactional platforms across banking, fintech and healthcare. I decouple legacy architectures into resilient cloud microservices. Cali, Colombia.
profileParagraph1: Solutions Architect and Systems Engineer with a double master's degree and more than 9 years leading the design and modernization of transactional technology platforms across banking, fintech and healthcare.
profileParagraph2: I tackle technical obsolescence, transactional latency and monolithic rigidity at high-demand corporate institutions, decoupling legacy architectures into resilient microservices and cloud environments that lift transactional throughput by up to 90% and cut processing times by 80%.
profileParagraph3: My work combines technical design under the C4 model, governance of API platforms and the definition of non-functional requirements —scalability, resilience and cybersecurity— with IT budget management, service level agreements and vendor negotiation.
profileParagraph4: On the generative AI front I structure reference architectures for Pro-code and Low-code agents, and enable cross-cutting integration capabilities with language models in regulated corporate environments.
setiExperienceDescription:
Led the design of reference architectures and cross-cutting technical governance for corporate banking systems.

• Designed and documented solution architectures using the C4 standard across its Context, Container and Deployment views, standardizing technical design and reducing architecture discrepancies between development and business teams.
• Structured reference architectures for intelligent agents, both Pro-code (Python with LangGraph, Java with Spring AI) and Low-code (n8n), accelerating proof-of-concept delivery and validation by 60% for corporate use cases.
• Enabled cross-cutting integration capabilities for large language models (LLMs), improving modular component reuse by more than 40% across the enterprise AI infrastructure.
• Led technical benchmarking and operational viability assessments of emerging platforms, guaranteeing interoperability and the secure coupling of 5 AI proofs of concept with the bank's transactional systems.
• Defined architecture guidelines focused on non-functional requirements —scalability, resilience and cybersecurity controls— minimizing the risk of sensitive data leakage in cloud environments and ensuring financial regulatory compliance.
• Coordinated technical alignment sessions with developers, IT engineers and cybersecurity teams, mitigating technical risk and meeting 100% of delivery agreements under banking regulation.
uccExperienceTitle: University Lecturer — Artificial Intelligence, Algorithms and Systems Thinking
uccExperienceDescription:
Adjunct lecturer at Universidad Cooperativa de Colombia, teaching core subjects such as Systems Thinking, Algorithms and Artificial Intelligence. I structure complex content clearly, pairing theory with practice to strengthen critical thinking and problem solving in students.

I foster a results-oriented learning culture, encouraging participation, innovation and teamwork in the classroom. The role complements my architecture work and keeps my view of applied AI trends current, connecting industry practice with the training of the next generation of engineers.
koralExperienceDescription:
Design and implementation of distributed architecture on AWS, core banking modernization and API platform governance.

• Designed the strategy to decouple the core system into a microservices architecture on .NET Core with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and CQRS, raising system concurrency capacity by 200% against transactional peaks.
• Technically led the integration with the Cobis Topaz core banking system, ensuring transactional consistency and cutting response times for complex financial queries by 70%.
• Executed the architectural migration from IBM API Connect to Gravitee API Manager, optimizing governance and traffic control of corporate APIs and cutting 45% in annual software licensing costs.
• Designed and implemented scalable AWS infrastructure using Docker containers, S3 storage and elastic compute services, reaching 99.95% platform availability in production environments.
• Structured continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines with Gitea and Docker, reducing time-to-market for new releases from 2 weeks to under 4 hours.
• Managed technical and budgetary agreements for AWS cloud consumption, restructuring resource sizing and generating recurring savings of 25% on the monthly cloud bill.
exsisExperienceDescription:
Consulting on software architecture remediation and cybersecurity, alongside completion of a master's degree in IT Management.

• Led the assessment and remediation of security vulnerabilities across corporate solutions in C#, ASP.NET and JavaScript together with internationally distributed technical cells.
• Coordinated the technical resolution of 95% of high-impact vulnerabilities and 60% of low-impact ones, strengthening operational stability, cybersecurity and platform quality standards.
• Took part in technical working groups within engineering squads, ensuring compliance with architecture guidelines and continuity of production services.
• Developed the applied research for my IT Management thesis on governance and architecture models, integrating strategic technology management frameworks aimed at mitigating technical debt.
coomevaExperienceDescription:
Strategic direction of software development, budget governance and modernization of transactional healthcare platforms.

• Comprehensively redesigned the transactional architecture of the online payments portal, optimizing processing times by 90% and reducing user abandonment from system failures to under 1%.
• Directed the strategic migration of the legacy AS400 core system to high-availability SQL Server relational databases, guaranteeing zero data loss and eliminating 80% of daily operational rework.
• Implemented an enterprise interoperability ecosystem through REST services in Java and SOAP architecture, securely connecting the business core with external platforms and reducing data exchange latency by 65%.
• Led the corporate integration with Salesforce CRM through Web Services and Active Directory, automating commercial lead management and shortening the user enrollment cycle by 35%.
• Managed and optimized annual technology budgets and software outsourcing contracts, negotiating stricter service level agreements (SLAs) that raised project delivery compliance from 75% to 96%.
• Led and mentored multidisciplinary development cells under agile methodologies (Scrum), achieving a sustained 30% increase in team velocity with no budget deviations.
palmettoExperienceDescription:
Professional continuity at an affiliated company under the same ownership, with responsibilities for accounting platform optimization and financial systems integration.

• Implemented a batch processing strategy, reducing accounting close times from ten hours to two per cycle, an 80% optimization.
• Optimized SQL queries, stored procedures and indexing strategies on SQL Server 2012, reducing lock contention by 60% during periods of high transactional demand.
• Structured the technical documentation and architectural integration diagrams for the accounting system, easing technology transfer and autonomous deployment of the solution at end clients.
taylorExperienceDescription:
Enterprise software design, accounting integration and data engineering for the financial sector.

• Designed and developed the architecture of the Generador Contable system using C#, ASP.NET and SQL Server, delivering a solution able to process more than five million records per month.
• Designed the interoperability layer with Oracle Financials and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), automating the reconciliation of accounting and financial information.
• Established coding standards, unit testing and architectural documentation across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), reducing defects found in user acceptance testing (UAT) by 40%.

projectsIntro: A selection of open-source projects that reflect my focus on architecture, code quality and modern engineering practices.
project_devsu_name: ProyectoDevsu — Banking microservices with asynchronous events (Java)
project_devsu_summary: Solution to the Devsu technical challenge: two Spring Boot microservices managing Customers, Accounts and Transactions in a banking domain, communicating asynchronously via RabbitMQ.
project_devsu_highlights: Hexagonal Architecture, database-per-service and CQRS-lite (local replica for reporting). OAuth2/OIDC security with Keycloak, secrets in Vault, migrations with Flyway. Unit, integration (Testcontainers) and E2E (Karate) tests. Documented C4 diagrams.
project_devsunet_summary: .NET version of the Devsu banking solution, showing stack-agnostic versatility: same OpenAPI contracts, same database schema and the same shared infrastructure as the Java version.
project_devsunet_highlights: Two ASP.NET Core microservices with Hexagonal Architecture, Entity Framework Core on PostgreSQL and asynchronous messaging with RabbitMQ. Keycloak (OIDC/JWT) + Vault, tests with xUnit and Testcontainers for .NET. Designed to run side by side with the Java version on the same infrastructure.
project_cachesystem_name: Cachesystem — Distributed cache with Spring Boot and Redis
project_cachesystem_summary: Distributed cache REST API built with Spring Boot 3, Redis 7 and Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters).
project_cachesystem_highlights: Native TTL support, errors with Problem Details (RFC 7807), OpenAPI documentation, integration tests with Testcontainers, multistage Docker image and a CI pipeline on GitHub Actions. Designed to show clean separation between domain, application and infrastructure.
project_hotelbooking_name: HotelBookingSolution — Booking management with .NET and DDD
project_hotelbooking_summary: Hotel booking administration platform built with .NET Core 8 and Domain-Driven Design, with clearly separated Domain, Application, Infrastructure and API layers.
project_hotelbooking_highlights: JWT authentication, persistence with Entity Framework Core on SQL Server, containerization with Docker Compose and E2E tests with Playwright alongside xUnit/MSTest. CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions.
skillsIntro: Technologies and disciplines I apply today in core banking modernization, cloud platforms and generative AI. More than 9 years working in these areas.
